item.title: Terrance Gore, a speedy outfielder who played for three World Series champions, dead at 34
item.description: Gore was mostly used as a pinch-runner and defensive replacement. He made his debut with the Kansas City Royals in 2014 and stole 23 bases before he got his first hit, a single to centre for the Cubs against Max Scherzer in the ninth inning of a 10-3 loss at Washington on Sept. 8, 2018.

item.title: SUNshine Girl Kelsey-Rose
item.description: SUNshine Girl Kelsey-Rose is autistic and wants to be a role model for others on the spectrum. Her hobbies include modelling and skating and she’d love to do more runway work. Kelsey-Rose, who posed for us in March 2019, is also into The Band Perry and Acqua. (Ernest Doroszuk/Toronto Sun)
